name: C3a Markdown Structural Enrichment
description: Every text-format chunk gets auto-populated _heading and _section_path metadata derived at ingest from markdown headings, via a new MarkdownEnricher and transient chunk start/end offsets propagated from the chunker.
effort: Small, contained to the ingest path: chunk record, chunker, one new enricher module, pipeline wiring. No storage schema change or migration, no new dependency. Risk is heading detection edge cases: fences, setext, restructured text, HTML, and offset alignment with stripped front matter.
